{{Top|leg}}
The '''Doloria''' were a cult of [[Assassin/Legends|assassins]] operating in the [[Corellian sector/Legends|Corellian sector]].<ref name="CCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

They were noted as being a fanatical group that was founded by [[Selonian/Legends|Selonians]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sacorria]]. Its members had a reverence toward Sacorrian traditions, although they held the same amount of reverence toward [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] that were earned during their work in the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Sector/Legends|sector]].<ref name="CCW" />
